name: version
label: Layout version
help_text: Version 1 shows the Rich text / Content max-width / Show top accent fields below. Version 2 shows the two column fields instead.

name: content
label: Rich text content
help_text: Version 1 (Full Width) only. Renders using the theme's global typography - no color settings on this module.
default:
One-Column Deep Dive Heading

Lead paragraph at a larger size sets up the whole section - one framing thought before the sub-sections begin.

First Sub-Head Carries an Argument

Body copy runs as long as the subject needs. Heading and paragraph pairs repeat as needed; a quote, table, or CTA strip can drop between any pair.

Second Sub-Head Continues the Thread

Second block of running copy. Inline links sit in brand purple; emphasis is bold, never italic caps.

name: content_width
label: Content max-width (desktop)
help_text: Caps the Rich text content's width on desktop (>= 768px) without changing the shared .content-wrapper width - content stays centered. Always full width on mobile. Version 1 (Full Width) only.

name: show_top_accent
label: Show top accent line
help_text: Optional decorative color bar above the Rich text content, matching the Hero module's accent line. Version 1 (Full Width) only.

name: content_col_1
label: Rich text - Column 1
help_text: Version 2 (Two Columns) only. Renders using the theme's global typography - no color settings on this module.
default:
Two-Column Heading Spans
Both Columns

Shared intro paragraph under the H2, then the copy splits into two equal columns that each carry their own sub-heads.

Column One Sub-Head

Column copy with full room - paragraphs stack inside the column, and each column can hold multiple Heading + paragraph pairs.

name: content_col_2
label: Rich text - Column 2
help_text: Version 2 (Two Columns) only. Renders using the theme's global typography - no color settings on this module.
default:
Column Two Sub-Head

Columns stay independent - never run one story across both. On mobile the second column stacks below the first.

Second Sub-Head in Column Two

Bulleted lists and inline links work inside columns exactly as in the Full Width version.

children.name: spacing_desktop
children.label: Desktop spacing
children.help_text: Top/bottom padding on desktop. Left/right are hidden - horizontal spacing comes from .content-wrapper.

children.name: spacing_mobile
children.label: Mobile spacing
children.help_text: Top/bottom padding at the theme's mobile breakpoint (max-width: 767px), independent of the desktop value above.
